title: Fix Visual Drag Propagation During Drag
prompt: Implement directional drag propagation in the Design 2D diagram with parent-fixed behavior. When dragging a node, move downstream children transitively. Parents never move. Persist in one transaction.
summary: Implemented directional drag propagation in Design 2D diagram. When dragging a node, all downstream descendants (via parentPieceId tree from piecesMetadata) move together preserving offsets. Parents and siblings stay fixed. Key changes: (1) getDownstreamDescendants utility computes BFS over parentPieceId tree, (2) onNodeDragStart computes descendants+offsets, (3) onNodeDrag moves descendants via internal node positions, (4) onNodeDragStop persists all updates in single transaction, (5) fixed bug where dragged node was not included in pendingPieceUpdates when not pre-selected, (6) exposed metadata to window for test accessibility, (7) added drag propagation test region verifying transitive chain propagation and center delta consistency.
